name: UG Healthcare Corporation Limited
summary: UG Healthcare Corporation Limited, an investment holding company established in Singapore in 1989, primarily engages in the manufacturing and worldwide distribution of disposable gloves. Its business is structured across three main segments: Latex Examination Gloves, Nitrile Examination Gloves, and a category for Other Ancillary Products. The company's offerings include both latex examination gloves, available in single and double chlorinated polymer-coated varieties, as well as nitrile examination gloves. Additionally, it supplies a range of supplementary items like surgical gloves, vinyl and cleanroom disposable gloves, face masks, various other medical disposables, and protective shoe covers. The firm also extends its expertise through business and management consultancy services. Its products serve diverse sectors such as healthcare, food and beverage, industrial and high-technology manufacturing, automotive, research and development, and the beauty industry. Operating under its "Unigloves" brand name, the corporation reaches customers across Malaysia, Europe, North America, South America, Africa, and the broader Asian market.
